dimensions.name: carve_out
dimensions.rationale: The agent resolved BOTH cms-platform refs (the `e2e-tests.yml` reusable-workflow call in deploy.yml and the `recursion-gate` composite-action call in .github/actions/gate/action.yml) to commit SHA `e76901db...`, the exact failure the skill forbids because it breaks cms-platform's pin-consistency lint and platform-bump's rewrite, and it offered no reasoning distinguishing first-party platform refs from third-party actions — treating them as just two more tags to pin.

dimensions.name: comment_removal
dimensions.rationale: The agent went the opposite direction on every count: it left the pre-existing trailing `# v4.1.0` comment on `actions/upload-artifact`, actively "fixed" `actions/cache` by adding a matching version comment, and appended brand-new trailing version comments to every ref it pinned (checkout, setup-node, and both cms-platform refs), even stating the comment convention as policy in its summary.

dimensions.name: restraint
dimensions.rationale: The agent edited the docker ref in lint.yml to add a digest and rewrote PINS.md with two new cms-platform rows plus an entirely new container-image digest table and a dateline edit — all out of scope — showing restraint only toward the local `./.github/actions/*` path refs, while also tacking on an unsolicited observation about a missing `local-lint` directory; the 7-day cooling-off consideration never came up.
